title: Single Gel System Based on Ahn T et al (2001)
author: Luisa F. Jiménez Soto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gipbudn
materials: Introduce the plate with the gel in a protein electrophoresis chamber , add the SDS- running buffer (for denaturing conditions) and run. Since this gel system does not have a stacking gel, it is better if you run the first 10 min at 90 V so that the proteins enter slowly in the gel. Then increase the voltage to 140 V and run for 55min (6%) to 75 min(>10%), or 240V for 20 min. Disclosure: The 240V for 20 min is only achieved using the Bio-Rad Running buffer. I am almost sure that I could increase the voltage above 240V with the Bio-Rad buffer, but only if I run the gel in cooling conditions or in pre-cooled buffer. The heat production at V >240V is visible in the way the proteins run.

steps.title: Prepare 2X buffer solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 250 ml of 2X buffer solution, ensuring all amino acids are fully solubilized.

substeps.instruction: Mix components; if solubilization is slow, warm to 37°C - 40°C and set pH as close as possible to the target pH.
Once amino acids are solubilized, measure and adjust the pH, then fill to the final volume.
Sterile filtrate the solution using a 0.22 µm filter.
Divide the buffer into 50 ml aliquots.

steps.title: Prepare glass for casting
steps.instruction: Prepare the glass plates for the gel casting process.

steps.title: Mix gel components
steps.instruction: Mix the gel components according to the lab reference table.

substeps.instruction: For Stain-Free gels, add Trichlorethanol solution at a 1:100 ratio.

steps.title: Pour and polymerize gel
steps.instruction: Pour the gel solution into the plate system and allow it to polymerize.

substeps.instruction: While the solution is liquid, pour it into the plate system (5 ml/mini-protean with 0.75 mm space) until the space is full.
Carefully introduce the required comb, ensuring no bubbles are trapped.
Allow the gel to polymerize for approximately 10-15 min.
